news.title: Most Americans favor big changes to the political system that likely would require amending the Constitution
news.summary_en: Most Americans support term limits, campaign spending caps, and Electoral College reform, but achieving these changes likely would require amending one of the world’s hardest constitutions to change.

news.title: Canadians and Mexicans now view China more positively than the U.S.
news.summary_en: Canadians and Mexicans also now view Chinese President Xi Jinping more positively than Trump, even as relatively few people in both countries have confidence in the two leaders.
